pages.text: Fit a $(item)Spawn Grate$() into a face of a Plasma Tank, in place of a glass or casing block, and the tank is a $(l)Mob Chamber$(). Once it is 15% full, mobs appear inside on their own, stand still and burn away in the plasma, four health a second.$(br2)What they drop goes into the tank's loot store, and their drops turn plasma into $(l)mob powers$() a Projector gives out.
The grate goes on a face, never an edge. It glows red on the inside, and its lamp flashes when a mob appears. No mob ever spawns in a tank without one.

A chamber spawns what its biome would spawn, and what a structure it stands in would (a fortress's blazes, a swamp hut's witches), as long as the mob fits inside. Light and floor do not matter.$(br2)A 4-wide chamber spawns every 30 seconds, 2 seconds sooner for each block wider: 14 seconds at 12 wide. It holds one mob for each 2 x 2 of inside floor, 16 at most.
pages.title: What spawns

pages.text: The switch on the tank screen's $(l)CHAMBER$() tab chooses $(l)ALL$(), $(l)HOSTILE$() or $(l)PASSIVE$() mobs. The tab lists every mob that can spawn in this chamber, how likely each is, and what its drop gives; it shows when the next comes and how many are alive.$(br2)Break the tank and the mobs inside wake up and walk away.
pages.title: The CHAMBER tab

pages.text: The loot store holds 27 stacks. A hopper or pipe on a Tank Port takes the loot out; nothing goes in that way. When the store is full, the rest is lost.$(br2)A wither skeleton's bones come out as $(item)Wither Bones$(). Breaking the tank spills the loot where the block broke.$(br2)Each kill also turns 10 mB of plain plasma into its drops' powers.
pages.title: The loot

pages.text: On the CHAMBER tab, click a drop that gives a power and pick level I, II or III. The chamber takes those items from the loot store, one at a time, and turns plain plasma into that power.$(br2)A bone, rotten flesh or string tags 24,000 mB at level I, a minute of a Projector; a stack, about an hour. Level II takes twice the items for the same plasma, level III four times. Rare drops tag five times as much; a spider eye a twentieth.
pages.title: Feeding a power

pages.text: Each power's plasma, and each level, is kept apart in the tank. To send one out, set a $(item)Tank Extractor$() against a Tank Port that gives plasma out (not one set to Input). Its $(l)<$() and $(l)>$() buttons pick plain, the totem's, or one mob power; it sends that into the cables touching it, highest level first, never back into its own tank. Projectors it feeds count its placer, their team and allies as the team. An Accelerator carries the power to another world.
pages.title: Sending it out

pages.text: The sight glass shows the colour of the plasma it sends.

A Projector fed with mob-power plasma gives out every mob power it brings, without using a channel, round itself: 16 blocks at level I, 24 at II, 32 at III. Each power burns its own plasma and stops when that runs out; plain plasma beside it keeps the Projector going but carries no power.$(br2)Team powers reach the owner, their team, friends with Ward access and allies with the Ward perk. Outsider powers reach everyone else, except new players under protection and players in creative.
pages.title: At a Projector

pages.text: $(l)Haste$(), from gunpowder: the team mines faster.$(br2)$(l)Fire Ward$(), from magma cream: fire and lava do not hurt the team.$(br2)$(l)Mending$(), from ghast tears: the team's held tools slowly mend.$(br2)$(l)Tide$(), from prismarine: the team breathes under water.
pages.title: Team powers

pages.text: $(l)Growth$(), from bones: crops, saplings and cane grow faster.$(br2)$(l)Keep$(), from slime balls: dropped items last 20 minutes.$(br2)$(l)Undead Ward$(), from rotten flesh: no zombies or skeletons spawn.$(br2)$(l)Lantern$(), from glowstone dust: no monsters spawn.
pages.title: Area powers

pages.text: $(l)Wither$(), from Wither Bones.$(br2)$(l)Snare$(), from string: outsiders move slowly.$(br2)$(l)Scorch$(), from blaze rods and coal: outsiders catch fire.$(br2)$(l)Warp Ward$(), from ender pearls: outsiders cannot pearl in or out.$(br2)$(l)Wireframe$(), from spider eyes: you see outsiders through walls.
pages.title: Outsider powers
